tools.title: Smear
tools.pitch: Spectral blur — sound smears through time, from intact pitch to infinite wash.
tools.audience: For sound designers and ambient producers who want motion frozen into texture.

tools.title: Gravity Well
tools.pitch: A spectral black hole — audio redshifts toward a floor frequency and time dilates as mass accumulates.
tools.audience: For sound designers chasing weight — scores, drones, sound that collapses inward.

tools.title: White Hole
tools.pitch: An anti-mass spectral leveler — buried detail lifts into audibility, peaks flatten toward the floor.
tools.audience: For producers who want buried detail surfaced without a compressor's pumping.

tools.title: Fracture
tools.pitch: Granular reverb — a reverb tail fragmented into crystalline, disintegrating decays.
tools.audience: For producers who want reverbs that fall apart beautifully instead of just fading.

tools.title: sampleViewer
tools.pitch: Your sample library as a navigable map — tempo, key, and sonic similarity, drag straight into your DAW.
tools.audience: For producers whose sample library outgrew their memory of it.

tools.title: anchor
tools.pitch: Web search → local-LLM synthesis with cited answers. Perplexity, without sending your queries anywhere.
tools.audience: For people who want cited answers without handing their questions to a cloud.

tools.title: Vox
tools.pitch: Offline dictation — hold a key, talk, and cleaned-up text lands in whatever window has focus.
tools.audience: For writers and devs who talk faster than they type and won't install cloud dictation.

tools.title: localAIVoiceover
tools.pitch: Local text-to-speech that reads your notes back as chapterized audiobooks.
tools.audience: For note-takers who want their writing read back — locally, on their own machine.

tools.title: Assay
tools.pitch: A dataset investigation workbench — from a raw download to verified findings.
tools.audience: For people who investigate datasets instead of just downloading them.

tools.title: indoorMaps
tools.pitch: Indoor mapping and wayfinding authoring — floors, rooms, doors, cross-floor routing.
tools.audience: For anyone who needs wayfinding in a building Google doesn't map.

tools.title: pokerCoach
tools.pitch: A single-player poker table that tracks the stats conversation — VPIP, PFR, aggression — while you play.
tools.audience: For players who want the numbers conversation without staking real tables.

tools.title: pomodoro-timer
tools.pitch: A desktop pomodoro timer that stays out of the way — tray-native, no account, no sync.
tools.audience: For desk workers who want a timer, not a productivity platform.

tools.title: claude-dispatch
tools.pitch: A dispatch hub for Claude Code sessions — queue work, launch sessions, watch tokens and cost.
tools.audience: For Claude Code users running more sessions than they can hold in their head.
